import requests

response = requests.get(url)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print("Entry type:", data.get("entryType"))
    print("Primary accession:", data.get("primaryAccession"))
    print("UniProt ID:", data.get("uniProtkbId"))
    print("Genes:", data.get("genes"))
    print("Protein description:", data.get("proteinDescription", {}).get("recommendedName", {}).get("fullName", {}).get("value"))
    print("Organism:", data.get("organism", {}).get("scientificName"))
else:
    print("Error:", response.status_code)
